$comment: REQ-CORPUS-2 (R1 §2, amended): the hard-fail denylist over every corpus-derived output — corpus, goldens, snapshots, real and synthetic. Single source read by both src/denylist.ts (the exporter's gate) and tools/demo-corpus/check-corpus.mjs (the always-run CI checker); denylist.test.ts pins parity. Bare Steven / Desktop / claude / operator / @example.com are deliberately NOT gated (content citations). Positive controls are the synthetic fixture's allowlisted lines; negative controls are synthesized in-test, never committed.
